briefdescription.para: Substitute a slow code sequence with a faster one by evaluating instruction combining pattern.

detaileddescription.para: The prototype of such a pattern is MUl + ADD -> MADD. Performs instruction combining based on machine trace metrics. Only combine a sequence of instructions when this neither lengthens the critical path nor increases resource pressure. When optimizing for codesize always combine when the new sequence is shorter.
